page.layout: One printed page: a title "Index IV." at the top centre; below it two parallel columns of a table (Cap. | Verf. | Pag.), separated by a double vertical rule; the left table runs from IX. to the foot, the right table from I. to the foot. No margin notes; no running head or page number.

main_text.head: Index IV.
main_text.l: Cap. | Verf. | Pag. || Cap. | Verf. | Pag.

page.notes: The title "Index IV." and the column heads are set in a larger italic/roman face; the header line is shown as one row. The double vertical rule divides the two tables. Some page numbers are faint in the scan (e.g. 1075, 1114, 1230) and are copied as they appear. The entry "I. AD CORINTH." is a sub-heading within the left table.
